author: Dan; implementation by Codex
range_exit_policy: Close all paper inventory at market when price reaches or crosses either low or high, regardless of direction. Stop priority cancels an order at the same edge. No 5% wait or 1% fallback. A gap executes at the observed quote and can still cause liquidation before a solvent close.

coverage.indicator_gaps: causal previous-close forward fill; no future seed
coverage.crossing_gaps: exclude synthetic minutes and crossings bridging gaps

historical_assumptions: Derive quote turnover from candle contract volume times contract multiplier times close; approximate not observed quote turnover.
Skip spread, depth and funding-window admission checks only in explicitly labeled candle-only filters mode.
Static contract metadata from the copied capture is a retrospective assumption, with survivorship and contract-change limitations.
Ten basis points full modeled spread when historical quotes are unavailable; retain actual quotes where available.
Missing minute extrema and intraminute OHLC order remain execution uncertainty.
Existing uncalibrated sizing may be used only for labeled sensitivity results pending independently observed quantities.
Public history traversal is not independent proof of complete funding coverage; missing rates are never verified zero.
amendment: Dan requires median-hold funding-aware positive grid economics, searched grid counts, multi-timeframe chart direction/range/entry and macro/SOL regime variants.
selection: At each hourly decision, test every feasible integer count 2..min(200, known venue maximum). Rank by min(last24h grid income/hour,last7d grid income/hour); deterministic count tie-break. Report top3. Outer four variants are reported individually, not selected by holdout performance.
minimum_grid_rule: At every adjacent price interval and for each active directional leg, actual modeled base quantity times interval minus both 0.06% fill fees minus expected signed funding must be positive. Admission uses max(0,funding cost), so credits cannot rescue a fee-floor failure. Default net safety reserve is at least 20% of both fees. No fixed1USDT floor.

funding.projection: Latest settled public rate available after an assumed60second publication lag; interval inferred causally from actual settlement timestamps, never a fixed8h default. Missing/irregular/stale terms leave adjusted net unknown and cannot arm a funded paper entry.
funding.hold: Empirical median completed-pair hold separately for each leg in24h and7d. Upper adjacent price notional; rate prorated over hold. Neutral funding legs never cancel for per-cycle admission.
funding.execution: Actual recorded settlement timestamps applied before orders at the same time, only to inventory already open. No fee or funding double-counting. Gap marks are estimates and coverage is not independently verified.

chart.swings: Confirmed pivots with2 closed bars on either side; no future pivot use.
chart.warmup: 55closed bars per timeframe; missing prehistory remains unknown. Finite causal fills may feed indicators and estimated pivots with minute-coverage confidence penalty.
chart.bias: 1d+4h agreement above0.75 confidence; disagreement/unknown ->Neutral.4h-only is a separate registered variant.
chart.range: Fresh1h support/resistance; observed1h extrema fallback disclosed; >=95% indicator-minute coverage, no raw7d range substitution.
chart.entry: Long/Short5m+15m pullback, never fresh high/low respectively. Neutral central20-80% band, no fresh breakout. Lower-timeframe coverage>=95%, latestsignal bucket contains actual observations; actual1m quote required for execution.

regime.macro: XBTUSDTM and ETHUSDTM4h+1d allup allowLong/Neutral; alldown allowShort/Neutral; mixed/unknownNeutral.
regime.sol: Known members intersect SOLUSDTM read. Maintained config list with citations; unclassified usesmacro gate with explicitSOL-not-appliedwarning.
regime.application: New entries only; record full readings and allowed directions. No forced close solely because regime changes.

replacement: Cost-aware income/hour improvement over6h must cover executable floatingclose loss plus close/openfees; no mandatory higherGPH if income improves. Underperformance is known trailing6h income belowhalf immutable startincome OR GPH<2. Under6h/unknown is notzero. No eligible replacement does not resurrect closed bots.

calibration.offers: Allowed only with estimated labels; no calibration gate on modeled radar offers.
calibration.deployment: No deployment or exchange execution authorized; evidence and separateaudit required.

research_status: July/August data and earlier-policy outputs have already been inspected. This registration precedes the amended strategy sweep, but these months are not claimed to be pristine unseen holdouts.

evaluation.start_event: Fresh matching paper_run_started only; source work and replay do not start the clock.

execution_limits: Source and detached-copy offline research only.
No credentials, account APIs, live orders, deployment, installed scheduler or runtime changes.
Public unauthenticated funding history retrieval only, shared token bucket and resumable sidecar checkpoints.
Report modeled results and coverage limitations separately; missingdata is never verified zero.
Exact range hit closes all positions; no profit-target stop.
